name: Champion · 概覽
note: The frame shared by all five pages (splash, name, page hint), with 概覽's own content. v3 as built: the splash fills the whole page behind it, no page titles and no 全部 button, the name at the foot (clear of the tab bar; only on this page, the others hide it), a dot per page at the top middle; 概覽 keeps the art bright with its parts just above the name. Tapping the chart, the tiles or the tags opens 全部概覽 (its page of its own). One left axis (Zaviel 2026-10-31): the stats start on the 16 px margin, the name is centred, the chart ends on the right margin, the tags are centred at the foot, under the name, even 20 px gaps down to the name. Positions drawn from the code on 2026-10-31 (not measured on a device). Captured from the app with Katarina (卡特蓮娜).
